name: emitter
meaning: embedded water-ripple emitter with inline storage (0x7c..0xf0): factory 0x4cdc54 sets slotPool = +0x24 (0x4cdc97), particles = +0x54 (0x4cdca2), count 4 (0x4cdcae) and calls Emitter_Reset 0x52dbe3 (0x4cdcb5) before the final vtable 0x576474 (0x4cdcbd); drawn flat by Render

name: fallTime
meaning: g_dt accumulated while falling (states 2, 7); drives ApplyFall; zeroed on landing/floating/drop

name: stateTime
meaning: g_gameTime at Respawn / state 12 entry / Init / Reset; 3 s hidden wait and 1 s wobble (a g_gameTime stamp compared unsigned, jb at 0x4cd1ee)

name: driftSpeed
meaning: water-flow drift speed (Math_ApproachLinear toward the zone flow speed, max 2000, accel 50, decel 100)

name: homePos
meaning: respawn position: = pos at Init and on msg 9 arg 1

name: carryYaw
meaning: (own facing - carrier facing) & 0xFFF when the Wolf lifts it inflated; attach rotation, restored on drop

name: driftHeading
meaning: heading of the water drift, stepped toward the zone flow heading at 0x2800/s

name: carryJoint
meaning: joint index from msg 4 arg; reused by AttachLink_SetParams after inflating

name: isFlags
meaning: InflatableSheepFlags: bit 0 inflated, bit 1 burnt (black tint; deflated by Reset)
